framing: Deterministic checks over method artifacts. This is the mechanical half of the Critic. It objects to nothing, scores nothing, admits nothing and parks nothing. A written attack is soften-critic's turn and is never auto-served.

checks.title: rule and control are compared at matched exposure
checks.detail: contrast is 'd_i = pnl_rule_fee_adj_i - pnl_baseline_fee_adj_i on the same n windows' with skip_contributes=0: a skipped window scores 0 against a baseline that filled, so the comparison rewards not playing rather than selecting

evidence.contrast: d_i = pnl_rule_fee_adj_i - pnl_baseline_fee_adj_i on the same n windows

checks.title: effect floor is not merely the detection floor
checks.detail: delta 0.28 vs MDE 0.2807 at n=40 (ratio 0.997). delta is within ~10% of the minimum detectable effect, so the bar can only see its own detection floor

checks.title: holdout is forward-only, not an index slice
checks.detail: held-out set is an index slice ('eligible windows 41 through 80 after declared_at') inside the same period and regime, which is not out of sample in any useful sense

checks.title: scoring runs on a fee-adjusted book

evidence.contrast: d_i = pnl_rule_fee_adj_i - pnl_baseline_fee_adj_i on the same n windows

checks.title: no rule is scored on a window that predates its declaration
checks.detail: no rule records a scored window at or before its declared_at

checks.title: trials_to_date is consistent with the register
checks.detail: trials_to_date=0 covers 0 rule(s) that have been looked at

checks.title: the public fee schedule is pinned by hash
checks.detail: no sha256 recorded for https://kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf; k=0.07 is being used on habit and a schedule change would be invisible

checks.title: the honesty stamp is inside one window
